Lemma
[Convexity and semicontinuity of $Df$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0451, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0452, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0453 ↗ lem:chow-iii-h25-directional-properties 1. apph:H.26\group Directional derivatives

For convex $f$, $V\mapsto D_Vf(p)$ is convex on $\T _pC$ (in Euclidean space directly, and on a locally Lipschitz Riemannian neighborhood by blow-up). The function $(p,V)\mapsto D_Vf(p)$ is upper semicontinuous.
